nom: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Water Gel Moisturizer

segments.oily: Many reviewers with oily skin report the gel hydrates without adding grease or excess shine, several calling it their favorite oily-skin moisturizer, though one with extremely oily/sensitive skin still found it left a fragrance she disliked.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin frequently report strong hydration lasting through the day, but several say the reformulated version left them drier, sticky, or itchy compared to the old formula, and one with very dry skin said it did not moisturize enough over time.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, often oily in the T-zone and dry elsewhere, describe the gel balancing both areas without breakouts, though one with combination/oily skin found it left her face dry.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it is one of the only moisturizers that doesn't burn, sting, or break them out, while others report burning, stinging, redness, or reactions they attribute to fragrance.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-dry, occasionally sensitive skin reports quick absorption and 24-hour softness with zero scent noticed.
segments.mature: A couple of reviewers describe use on mature skin (50s-60s), reporting smooth, plumped, younger-looking results with no pore-clogging.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it against aging report plumped, smoother, younger-looking skin, including a 55-year-old and a 63-year-old citing visible improvement.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report significant, fast-absorbing hydration lasting all day or 24 hours; a minority say the new formula or long-term use left skin drier than expected or not moisturizing enough on its own.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report red, itchy patches or a reddish breakout after the reformulation, generally linked to the added fragrance, especially on sensitive skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with fungal acne and oily skin reports her skin barrier feeling almost healed within two days; others report burning or stinging on application suggesting barrier irritation instead.
concerns.spots: Some reviewers say it helped clear or reduce acne and breakouts even on acne-prone skin; several others report the reformulated version caused new or worsened breakouts, clogged pores, and cystic-feeling irritation.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and even improvement in complexion, while multiple others (mostly citing the reformulation) report worsened breakouts and clogged pores.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers frequently report the gel controls shine and reduces excess oil/sebum through the day without feeling greasy; one reviewer felt it was too heavy and pilled instead.

aspects.libelle: Reformulation seen as worse than original
Pills or clashes when layered with makeup

extraits.texte: I have used this moisturizer for years and absolutely LOVED it! Was wonderful for my combo-acne prone skin. Just got the new formula with my latest order and it's wrecking my skin. Has worsened breakouts, less moisturizing, and stings a little.

Has frgrance which caused a reaction in my sensitive skin. I purchased this as it came recommended from a dermatologist, but unfortunately my sensitive skin was looking for hyaluronic acid and not frgrance so my face had a reddish breakout.

extraits.titre: Did not moisturize as well as I hoped!
extraits.texte: I like this product! It certainly did not cause me to break out, which is huge because a lot of moisturizers do. However, it did not moisturize as well as I hoped it would. I have very dry skin, and had been using Kiehls Ultra Facial Cream prior to trying this. I was hoping this would be a less expensive alternative, but after about 6 weeks of using this, I am definitely starting to get a bit dry again. This product also doesn't last nearly as long as Kiehls UFC, so back to Kiehls it is!

Ok so i have combo skin that is oily in my t-zone and dry pretty much everywhere else. I used to have to apply so much powder on my nose to try and hide my oil. BUT since using this it has balanced my skin so well!!! I also have acne prone skin and it helped moisturize and clear up my skin. Im not even joking when i say this absorbs so fast. And my skin is so soft. 10/10 recommend

I have been using this product for about a month now consistently/majority of the time. I needed new products as I am currently 6 months pregnant and I was having a horrible reaction to the products I was using. I also have very sensitive skin and multiple allergies, so skin care has always been a struggle for me. Since starting these products, my face has been so smooth, no reactions/breakouts and I have noticed a difference in my skin overall. I am really hoping the results stay the same after pregnancy. Below is my routine. I wait 2-5 minutes before applying the next product. MORNING: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Foaming Face Wash (does not leave my face feeling stripped or dry, size is worth the money) cocokind Vitamin C Glow Brightening Serum (sometimes there is a very slight burn but nothing that is concerning or leaves any after affects such as burns or spots on the face) Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Water Gel Moisturizer (was worried about using this product but my skin has been handling it perfectly) cocokind Daily SPF 32 Mineral Facial Sunscreen (no burn, as long as you use the right amount it does not cake on thick. I use 2-3 fingers of product) NIGHT: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Foaming Face Wash cocokind Vitamin C Glow Brightening Serum Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Water Gel Moisturizer

extraits.titre: My fungal acne is almost gone after three uses.
extraits.texte: I am not the type to write a review. This product is amazing! I have fungal acne and oily skin, so I need to be very conscious and aware of the ingredients in products I apply to my skin. In just two days, my skin barrier is almost completely healed.

extraits.titre: Made for dry and sensitive skin
extraits.texte: My skin is super dry and has always been a struggle to treat on top of being sensitive. This leaves my skin happy and hydrated.
